operations.text:
- Step 1: write acceptance tests first in specs/test_artefacts/acceptance/test_e3_s1_verification.py (AC1-AC5), run record-at-red.js while red; API tests in backend/tests/api/test_verification.py; repo tests in backend/tests/repo/test_documents_repo.py (queue listing oldest-uploaded-first, mark_verified, mark_rejected)
- Step 2: extend backend/src/truelend/repository/documents_repo.py (list_uploaded_queue: paginated UPLOADED documents across all applications, oldest uploaded_at first; get_by_id: a single document row by id, any application; mark_verified: status VERIFIED, verified_by, verified_at, clears reason; mark_rejected: status REJECTED, reason, verified_by, verified_at); no new migration (application_documents already has verified_by/verified_at/reason from 0003)
- Step 3: add backend/src/truelend/service/verification_service.py (list_queue: maps the repo page to document_id/application_id/type items; decide_document: 404 NOT_FOUND for an unknown document_id, 409 ALREADY_VERIFIED when the document is already VERIFIED (final, SG implied by E1-S2-AC4 no orphan audit row on 409), else marks VERIFIED or REJECTED and writes the DOCUMENT_VERIFIED/DOCUMENT_REJECTED audit row via audit_repo.insert in the same transaction as the state change, then commits)
- Step 4: add backend/src/truelend/api/documents_router.py (GET /api/verification-queue and POST /api/documents/{id}/verify, both UNDERWRITER only via require_roles; the verify request body validates outcome Literal["VERIFIED","REJECTED"] and reason via Field(min_length=1, max_length=500) so a missing/empty/501-char reason is rejected by Pydantic as 422 VALIDATION_ERROR before the service or any audit write runs); register documents_router in backend/src/truelend/api/main.py; add AlreadyVerifiedError(ConflictError) to backend/src/truelend/types/errors.py
